title: Cold storage, revenue conflict + big TIV
text:
From: marco.ruiz@atlanticriskpartners.com
Subject: RE: Harbor Point Cold Storage - property renewal submission

Team - resending with corrected financials. Harbor Point Cold Storage Inc. runs refrigerated warehousing (NAICS 493120) out of Newark, NJ, in business 22 years.
Earlier email said revenue of $18M; correction: FY2025 audited revenue is $16.5M, please use that.

State: NJ
Annual revenue: 18,000,000

Statement of values
Bldg A (freezer) ..... $38,000,000

TOTAL TIV ............ $62,000,000
